name: smwgraphics-mega-man-boss-variant
title: Mega Man (Boss Variant)
description:
The classic NES Mega Man, now in boss form!

Meant to be used with the Kirby Boss.

Make sure to replace the cfg files with the ones included, since Mega Man uses palette F. (Since its easier for you to add new forms and abilities, and because I didn't want to mess with Palette C)

Uses SP3 and SP4.

That's all, have fun!
